title: Recreation Centre Gym Equipment Upgrade
description:
Tender Details : Massey University is seeking quotations from suitably qualified suppliers for the supply, delivery, installation and commissioning of commercial gym equipment for its Recreation Centres located in Auckland, Palmerston North and Wellington.

The RFQ consists of multiple equipment lots, including cardio equipment, strength machines, and free weights/accessories. Suppliers may submit responses for one, multiple, or all lots.

Suppliers must be able to provide commercial-grade equipment suitable for high-use recreation environments and demonstrate appropriate warranty, servicing, and parts support within New Zealand.

Delivery and installation are anticipated between September and December 2026.

Full requirements, specifications, and pricing schedules are provided in the RFQ documentation.

Issued by : Massey University
Closing Date : 22/Jul/2026 11:00 am (UTC+12:00) Auckland, Wellington time

title: Enterprise Network Refresh (Solution)
description:
Tender Details : Massey University is seeking a strategic delivery partner to design, supply, implement, and support a full refresh of its enterprise network infrastructure across all campuses.

The solution must address ageing infrastructure, increasing cybersecurity risk, and capacity constraints, delivering a secure, resilient, scalable, and cloud-ready network platform that supports research, teaching, and operational needs.

The successful Respondent will provide:

• Network hardware and software platforms

• Design, integration, and implementation services

• Ongoing support and managed services

• A commercial model supporting both capital and service-based approaches (including NaaS)

Please note that this RFP (and any contractual commitment) is issued subject to Massey University Council approval of the Network Refresh Business Case (anticipated mid-July 2026).

title: Asbestos Property Survey and reinspection
description:
Tender Details : Waimakariri District Council is seeking registrations of interest from suitably qualified and experienced asbestos surveying consultancies to support the next stage of its district-wide asbestos management programme.

The opportunity covers a diverse portfolio of Council-owned buildings and structures and is expected to include surveys of previously unsurveyed pre-2000 assets, reinspections of known asbestos-containing materials, confirmatory sampling, and correction of existing survey and register information where required. The final delivery approach may comprise a combination of targeted reinspections and full management surveys, with priority given to unsurveyed properties and locations containing higher-risk materials.

description:

title: CON26/29 Blake Street Carpark Redevelopment - Registration of Interest
description:
Tender Details : This Registration of Interest is the first stage of procurement for the redevelopment and expansion of the Blake Street Public Carpark in Rangiora Township.

The works will include:

- Stripping, relevelling, and resurfacing of the bulk carpark area.

- Replacement of approximately 130m of AC watermain with new DN150-DN200

- Removal of existing kerbs, gardens, and lighting assets

- Construct new kerbs, channels, and additional underground drainage to tie into the existing network

- High amenity paving areas with street furniture

- Adjusting the existing lighting network including installing and commissioning new poles and luminaires, and extending the cable and duct network

- New carpark linemarking and signage

- Construction of new garden areas and tree pits ready for planting (by others)

title: Audio Visual Technology: Supply, Delivery & Support
description:
Tender Details : Services for design, supply, install, test, certify, warranty and support of Audio-Visual (AV) technology along with the necessary physical infrastructure (lecterns, sensors, microphones, document scanners, controllers and display equipment)—across Massey’s three campuses. Delivery of these services must conform to strict technical standards and documentation requirements provided by Massey.





The outcome of the procurement is to identify a single national supplier who can provide the services outlined above at each of the Massey campuses – Auckland, Manawatu, and Wellington. However, Massey University reserves the right to appoint one or more suppliers, including on a campus-by-campus basis, where this represents the best overall procurement outcome.
